properties.name: MEASURED 2026-09-22: a brainstorm ran ZERO read-path searches and missed six-plus existing nodes — and the one guard that did fire returned only nodes the same session had written minutes earlier, so it confirmed the agent's framing instead of challenging it
properties.statement:
ANTHONY ASKED FOR THIS ROOT CAUSE, 2026-09-22: why did a brainstorm on his founding chain miss content that a search found one prompt later, and was it because his second prompt named specifics the first did not?

ANSWER: BOTH, IN MEASURABLE PROPORTIONS, PLUS A THIRD CAUSE NEITHER OF US NAMED.

═══ ① THE FIRST TURN RAN NO READ-PATH SEARCH AT ALL ═══

Tool calls before writing, turn 1: `scan_nodes(Capability)` and one ToolSearch. **Zero `search_design` calls.** Turn 2, after he said the graph already held this: **five**. That is the whole difference in behaviour, and it was a choice — turn 1 framed the task as MEASURE THE CHAIN and went to counters, satisfying the brainstorm skill's "link to what exists" step with the write guard instead of a search.

⭐ THIS IS A RECORDED CLASS, AND THE RECORD PREDICTS IT EXACTLY. `dec:idea-search-first-fires-without-being-remembered`: "ALL SIX HAPPENED ON THE READ PATH, WHERE NOTHING ENFORCES ANYTHING. The refusal fires on add_requirement / add_capability / add_component / add_decision / add_constraint. It cannot fire when a user asks a question and an agent answers in prose… it degrades silently in a long session precisely when the graph is large enough to make searching most valuable." This session was ten hours old and the graph is 5,100 nodes.

═══ ② THE VOCABULARY GAP IS REAL AND ONLY PARTIAL — MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED ═══

His question was whether prompt 2's specifics were the cause. Tested by searching with ONLY prompt 1's language, no prompt-2 nouns:

    FOUND on prompt-1 words alone:  dec:idea-lifecycle-dimensions-on-a-requirement
                                    dec:idea-cost-to-change-is-read-from-lifecycle-phase
                                    cap:recover-from-tests
                                    req:scenarios-are-modelled
    NOT FOUND until prompt-2 nouns: cap:revise-trigger, cap:fork-alternatives,
                                    req:roads-not-taken, dec:reopen-supersedes,
                                    dec:fork-point-address, dec:alternatives-unranked-forkable

⇒ SO HIS HYPOTHESIS IS HALF RIGHT AND THE HALF IT IS WRONG ABOUT IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS. The FORK cluster genuinely needed words he had not yet used — BM25 is lexical, and "go back to the decision point" does not match "fork", "alternative" or "re-open". But the LIFECYCLE cluster was reachable from his first prompt and was missed for no reason but not looking. One of those nodes was linked an hour later as ANTICIPATES, which is the proof it belonged in the first answer.

═══ 🛑 ③ THE CAUSE NEITHER OF US NAMED: THE GUARD WAS AN ECHO CHAMBER ═══

The write-path guard DID fire — four times, on the finding and three decisions. Every near-match it returned was a node THIS SESSION HAD WRITTEN MINUTES EARLIER. Not one older node appeared. The mechanism: the guard scores candidates against the new node's own text, so nodes sharing the agent's fresh phrasing outrank decade-old design nodes written in reflow2's vocabulary — and the cap of 3 (`fact:the-near-match-guard-shows-three-of-a-nine-way-tie-so-relevance-is-decided-by-score-noise`, found the same day) guarantees those three slots are taken by the session's own output.

⭐ SO THE ONE CHECK THAT RAN ACTIVELY CONFIRMED THE AGENT'S FRAMING. It is worse than no check for this purpose: it returns a plausible-looking near-match list, which reads as "I looked and the design holds nothing else". A guard that can only surface what you just said is a mirror, and the session read it as a window.

⚠️ AND IT COMPOUNDS WITH THE CAP DEFECT RATHER THAN BEING A SECOND INSTANCE OF IT. Raising the limit to 6 (merged today as #561) does not fix this: on a long session the agent's own fresh nodes will still crowd the top slots, because they are the ones written in the query's exact words.

═══ ⑥ THE CLASS, AND WHY THE INSTANCE FIX IS NOT ENOUGH ═══

Would fixing only turn 1 have prevented the others? No. This is the same class as flo2 rebuilding four things reflow2 already served, as the six measured saves in one 2026-08-12 session, and as `fact:the-served-instructions-name-no-way-to-ask-whether-a-thing-already-exists-and-one-consumer-rebuilt-four-that-did`. Every instance is the READ path, where the discipline is written in five skills and enforced by nothing.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether a read-path trigger is affordable. Option A on the recorded idea needs the agent to volunteer its query, which is the same trigger problem one layer down, and that is precisely why the node is still open rather than built.
